'''Bernard Chevassus-au-Louis''' (born January 24, 1949, in [[Paris]]) is a French biologist and ecologist, who served as the president of the [[National Museum of Natural History, France]] from 2002 to 2006. He was knighted with the [[Ordre national du Mérite]] in 2001.<ref>{{cite news |title=La biodiversité selon P. Chevassus-au-Louis |url=https://abonne.lest-eclair.fr/id1260/article/2018-10-08/la-biodiversite-selon-p-chevassus-au-louis |access-date=6 April 2022 |work=Journal L'Est Éclair abonné |date=8 October 2018 |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=[NOMINATION] Bernard Chevassus-au-Louis élu président d'Humanité et Biodiversité |url=https://www.actu-environnement.com/ae/news/bernard-chevassus-au-louis-association-humanite-biodiversite-24051.php4 |access-date=6 April 2022 |work=Actu-Environnement |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Bernard Chevassus-au-Louis : Au jardin, de la patience et du bon sens |url=https://www.jardinsdefrance.org/bernard-chevassusau-louis-au-jardin-de-la-patience-et-du-bon-sens/ |access-date=6 April 2022 |work=Jardins de France |language=fr-FR}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Bernard CHEVASSUS-AU-LOUIS {{!}} Académie d'Agriculture de France |url=https://www.academie-agriculture.fr/membres/annuaire/bernard-chevassus-au-louis |website=www.academie-agriculture.fr |access-date=6 April 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Bernard Chevassus-au-Louis |url=http://www.cgedd.developpement-durable.gouv.fr/IMG/pdf/CV_chevassus_cle7b2cfb.pdf |website=CGEDD |access-date=6 April 2022 |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Decree of 14 May 2001 on promotion and appointment |url=https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/WAspad/UnTexteDeJorf?numjo=PREX0104833D |website=www.legifrance.gouv.fr |access-date=6 April 2022 |language=fr}}</ref>
